blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Adapting prose into a script requires transforming narration and inner experience into scenes that convey relationships and psychological contradictions. Planning specifies intended effects but leaves their realization in dialogue and action unresolved. Drawing on screenwriters' accounts of revising scenes and their connections to the surrounding work, we present SceneWeave, which uses alternative scene drafts to revise the adaptation as a whole. It writes contrasting treatments of a focal scene, compares the interactions they create, and revises characterization, preceding preparation, subsequent development, and scene order before generating the complete script. The central contribution is to use actual scene writing to inform adaptation decisions and propagate their consequences across the work. We also develop a task-specific writing model and a human-preference model for comparing script drafts. The writing model learns from adaptation examples and human preferences; the preference model combines human and synthetic supervision. Blind reader comparisons favor SceneWeave over a baseline workflow and description-based controls, while content assessment indicates reduced narrative redundancy and strong psychological treatment.
blocks.zh: 将通俗改编为剧本需要将叙事和内在经历转化为传达关系和心理矛盾的场景. 规划明确了预期效果,但通过对话和行动实现这些效果。 我们借鉴编剧们关于修订场景及其与周边作品的关联的叙述,呈现出SceneWeave,它使用另类场景草稿来修改整体的改编. 它书写了对焦场景的对比处理,比较了它们创造的相互作用,并在生成完整的脚本之前修改了特征,前作准备,后作发展和场景顺序. 中心贡献是利用实际现场写作为适应决定提供信息,并在整个工作中宣传其后果。 我们还开发了针对特定任务的写作模式和比较脚本草稿的人文偏好模式. 写作模式学习了适应实例和人类偏好;偏好模式结合了人和合成监督. 盲人阅读器比较偏向于SceneWeave,优于基线工作流程和基于描述的控制,而内容评估则表明叙事冗余性降低并有强烈的心理治疗.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Prose conveys relationships through narration, perspective, memory, and unspoken thoughts. Adaptation must decide how these meanings emerge in performance. It may bring separated characters together, redistribute initiative, replace an event, or let an ordinary exchange carry a psychological contradiction. The resulting script determines whether these changes work.
blocks.zh: Prose通过叙事,视角,记忆,和无言的思想来传达关系. 适应必须决定这些含义如何在业绩中出现。 它可能将分离的人物聚集在一起,重新分配主动性,替换一个事件,或者让普通的交换带有心理矛盾. 由此产生的脚本决定这些更改是否工作.

blocks.en: Large language model (LLM) writing systems support detailed planning, candidate selection, and local and global revision ( Yang et al., 2022 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) . Novel-to-screenplay generation has also been investigated ( Lin et al., 2025 ) . We examine whether writing alternative scenes before finalizing an adaptation improves decisions about characterization and scene organization.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLM)书写系统支持详细规划,候选人选择,以及地方和全球修订(杨等人,2022年;杨等人,2023年;吴等人,2026年;谢等人,2025年). 小说到屏幕游戏的生成也被调查(Lin等人,2025年). 我们审查在最后敲定一项修改之前是否写下其他的场景,从而改进关于定性和场景组织的决定。

blocks.en: In Gerwig’s adaptation of Little Women , an outline could reduce Amy’s wish to marry a wealthy man to a calculating trait. In the film, Laurie appeals to love, and Amy counters that marriage determines her financial and legal future; Gerwig reports writing much of this exchange shortly before filming ( August and Gerwig, 2020 ) . Their disagreement brings desire, dependence, and unequal freedom into the same encounter. If Amy simply announced her plan, the choice would carry a different meaning. Writing both treatments would expose that difference and help revise her earlier characterization and the later development of their relationship.
blocks.zh: 在格维希对小女人的改编中, 在影片中,劳里呼吁爱,艾米反驳说婚姻决定了她的经济和法律未来;Gerwig报告在拍摄前不久(2020年8月和Gerwig)写下了大部分这种交流. 他们的分歧使欲望、依赖和不平等的自由进入了同样的境地。 如果艾米只是宣布了她的计划,选择将具有不同的意义. 写两种治疗方法都会暴露这种差异,并有助于修改她早先的特征和后来的关系发展.

blocks.en: Screenwriting practice motivates revisiting the connections between a scene and the surrounding work. Sciamma describes a late scene invention that links a love story with its later memory ( Sciamma, 2019 ) ; Gerwig discusses how interleaving timelines change the emotional meaning of encounters ( August and Gerwig, 2020 ) . Birch describes discovering possibilities through formal constraints, while Straughan relates public ritual to private conduct in a particular adaptation ( Birch, 2024 ; Focus Features, 2024 ) . These accounts inform our treatment of expression and arrangement as revisable creative decisions.
blocks.zh: 屏幕写作实践激励人们重新审视一个场景与周围作品之间的联系. Sciamma描述了一个晚期的场景发明,该发明将爱情故事与后来的记忆联系起来(Sciamma, 2019);Gerwig讨论了交际时间如何改变相遇的情感意义(August and Gerwig, 2020). Birch描述了通过形式约束发现可能性,而Stroughan则将公共仪式与特定适应中的私人行为联系起来(Birch, 2024; Focus Features, 2024). 这些说法为我们将表达和安排视为可改写的创造性决定提供了依据。

blocks.en: SceneWeave uses alternative scene drafts to revise the adaptation plan and generate the complete script (Figure 1 ). We evaluate the full method against a planning-and-refinement baseline and examine the contribution of written scenes through two mechanism controls. The implementation is available on GitHub 1 1 1 https://github.com/Aolin-MIR/SceneWeave , with model and evaluation artifacts in a companion Zenodo record 2 2 2 https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23329962 .

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Recursive Reprompting and Revision (Re3) combines an overarching plan, recursive contextual prompting, reranking, and consistency editing ( Yang et al., 2022 ) ; Detailed Outline Control (DOC) uses detailed hierarchical outlines and generation control ( Yang et al., 2023 ) . Agents’ Room separates planning and writing through a shared scratchpad ( Huot et al., 2025 ) . SuperWriter combines planning, incremental writing, and refinement with stage-specific supervision and hierarchical direct preference optimization (DPO) ( Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 递归回转和修订(Re3)结合了总体计划,递归上下文提示,重新排位,一致性编辑(杨等人,2022年);详细大纲控制(DOC)采用详细的分级大纲和生成控制(杨等人,2023年). 代理商室通过一个共享的抓刀将规划和写作分开(Huot等人,2025年)。 SuperWriter将规划,增量写作,细化与阶段性监督,分级直接偏好优化(DPO)(Wu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Dramatron hierarchically generates characters, plot beats, locations, and dialogue for human co-writing ( Mirowski et al., 2023 ) . Reader–Rewriter ( R 2 R^{2} ) extracts novel characters and event graphs, then creates outlines and scenes with hallucination-aware refinement ( Lin et al., 2025 ) ; its graph traversals support main-storyline, chronological, and chapter-order adaptation. Dramaturge coordinates global, scene-level, and cross-scene revisions ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , while DuoDrama generates inner experience and actor-perspective questions for human reflection ( Tang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 戏剧分级生成人物,情节节拍,地点,以及人类共写的对话(Mirowski等人,2023年). 读者–Rewriter (R 2 R^{2}) 摘录小说人物和事件图表,然后用幻觉感知的精细(Lin et al., 2025)创建大纲和场景;其图轨支持主故事线,时间顺序,章节顺序的调整. 戏剧协调全球,场景层面,以及跨场景修改(谢等人,2025年),而DuoDrama则产生内在体验和演员视角问题,供人类反思(唐等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Language Model Authored, Manually Polished (LAMP) provides professional paragraph edits and a taxonomy of recurring problems ( Chakrabarty et al., 2025b ) . Writing Quality Reward Models learn from edits and select paragraph revisions ( Chakrabarty et al., 2025a ) ; LitBench trains verifiers on human story preferences and evaluates new story rankings ( Fein et al., 2026 ) . Our assessment of presentation-order reliability is motivated by Wang et al. (2024a) .
blocks.zh: 语言模型作者、手动波兰语(LAMP)提供了专业段落编辑和反复出现问题的分类(Chakrabarty等人,2025b)。 写作"质量奖励模型"从编辑和选择段落修改中学习(Chakrabarty等人,2025年a);Lit Bench训练验证人关于人类故事偏好并评价新故事排名(Fein等人,2026年). 我们对列报顺序可靠性的评估由Wang等人(2024a)推动。

blocks.zh: 审查产生修订建议q q. 鉴于同样的情况,模式决定采用和更新计划和现场任务的建议。 书写模式使用修改后的上下文和q q 执行最高优先被接受的建议,生成y 2 y _{2}.

blocks.en: 5 Preference Learning and Adaptation Strategies
blocks.zh: 5 优先学习和适应战略

blocks.en: 5.1 Learning audience preferences
blocks.zh: 5.1 学习对象偏好

blocks.en: We fine-tune a two-billion-parameter decision model as the comparator using LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , retaining its public pointer head for A, B, and tie ( Strands Agents, 2026 ) . Its 3,000 training comparisons comprise 269 human and 2,731 synthetic records; six human records express indifference. Human labels come from Arena, PPE, and HelpSteer2/3 ( Arena, ; Frick et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Screening retains dramatic-writing requests with their context and original labels. Human examples guide synthetic annotation. Study partitions group related works, tasks, authors, and adaptations (Appendix B ).
blocks.zh: 我们用LORA(Hu et al., 2022年)来调整一个20亿参数的决定模型, 其3 000项培训比较包括269项人类记录和2 731项合成记录;6项人类记录表示漠不关心。 人类的标签来自Arena,PPE,和HelpSteer2/3(Arena, ;Frick等人, 2024年;Wang等人, 2024年b;Wang等人, 2025年b). 筛选保留带有上下文和原标签的戏剧写作请求. 人类的例子指导合成注解. 研究分区组相关作品,任务,作者,和改编(附录B ).

blocks.en: 5.2 Alternative adaptation strategies
blocks.zh: 5.2 替代性适应战略

blocks.en: Authors choose an approach according to their intended treatment. An optional LLM recommendation uses the source and brief to compare the opportunities and risks of the four strategies. Strategy order is randomized; writing receives the chosen strategy and the shared initial plan and draft.
blocks.zh: 作者根据他们的预期待遇选择一种方法. 一项可选的LLM建议利用来源和简况来比较这四项战略的机会和风险. 战略顺序是随机的;写作收到选择的战略以及共享的初步计划和草稿.

blocks.en: This approach writes two alternative sequences of linked encounters to develop particular relationships. Each encounter is written from the current interpretation and preceding encounters. After each encounter, a separate interpretation step revises the account of how characters act toward one another, retaining unresolved questions and continuity with earlier encounters; the revised interpretation informs the next encounter and plan revision. The character-interpretation step uses an adapted version of Dramaturge’s publicly released instruction ( Xie et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 这种方法书写了两个互相关联的交会顺序,以发展特定的关系. 每次相遇都是根据目前的解释和之前的相遇而写成的. 每次相遇后,一个单独的解释步骤会修改人物如何相互配合的说法,保留未解决的问题和与以前相遇的连续性;经过修改的解释会为下一次相遇提供信息,并计划修改. 角色诠释步骤使用改编版的Dramaturge公开发布指令(Xie等人,2025年).

blocks.en: The provisional scenes are grouped into sections with an explicit presentation order, including nonlinear arrangements. Before writing each scene, its task is expanded using the written prefix and current arrangement, and the plan is revised accordingly. This procedure builds on hierarchical outline planning ( Yang et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 临时场景分为有明确展示顺序的章节,包括非线性安排. 在写出每个场景之前,其任务使用书面前缀和当前安排进行扩展,计划也相应修改. 该程序基于分级大纲规划(杨等人,2023年;吴等人,2026年).

blocks.en: A scene-level treatment describes what narrative perspective, imagery, rhythm, or interior expression contributes. The approach assigns expressive units—speech, voice, action, silence, image, sound, space, and time—and converts them into scenes using the written prefix. Interpretation records indicate how these units are used, transformed, or omitted, and where their treatment remains uncertain. Once the sequence is written, the generator proposes a different arrangement of expressive elements and writes an alternative scene in its preceding and following context. An interpretation step compares the two scene treatments without favoring any expressive channel. The original sequence and alternative scene provide separate inputs for updating the full adaptation plan.
blocks.zh: 场景层面的治疗描述了叙事视角,图像,节奏,或内饰表达的贡献. 这种方法指定了表达单位——语音,语音,动作,沉默,图像,声音,空间,以及时间——并使用书面前缀将其转换成场景. 口译记录表明这些单元是如何使用、转变或省略的,以及如何处理这些单元仍然不确定。 序列写完后,生成器会提出不同的表达元素安排,并在其前后的上下文中写出另一个场景. 一个解释步骤比较了两个场景的治疗方法,而没有偏向任何表现道. 最初的顺序和替代场景为全面适应计划的更新提供了单独的投入.

blocks.en: These approaches feed into the plan-update and complete-writing sequence in Section 4 , using their scene drafts or encounter sequences (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 这些方法利用它们的场景草稿或遭遇序列(图2),输入第4节中的计划更新和完整编写序列。

blocks.en: 6 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6. 评价

blocks.en: 6.1 Sources and reproducible conditions
blocks.zh: 6.1 来源和可复制条件

blocks.en: Evaluation draws on a privately held prose collection. Twenty prose-fiction works from 17 author groups are held out using a deterministic ordering of work identifiers within a work-level partition. Each eligible work contributes a supplied source passage, preceding prose context, and adaptation brief. Source paragraphs are extracted directly from the prose, without using screenplays to retrieve the source passages. Known work, adaptation-family, and author links and actual text fingerprints are checked against study training inputs and targets. Passage reviews specify their bounded scope. Source manifests retain medium, language, scope, fixed requirements, and all permitted edits.
blocks.zh: 评价借鉴了私人收藏的散文。 来自17个作者团体的20篇造谣作品,在工作分区内使用确定性的工作标识。 每一份符合条件的工作都提供一条源代码、前传言背景和适应简报。 源段落直接从散文中提取,不使用剧本检索源段落. 对照学习培训的投入和目标,检查已知的工作、适应-家庭、作者链接和实际文字指纹。 通行证审查规定其范围。 原始清单保留了介质、语言、范围、固定要求和所有允许的编辑。

blocks.en: All four conditions use gpt-6-luna for writing, planning, plan revision, and script review. They share the source, brief, initial plan and draft, and instructions for common tasks. Prompts, decoding settings, and source selection are fixed before evaluation.
blocks.zh: 所有四个条件都使用gpt-6-luna用于写作,规划,计划修订和脚本审查. 他们分享来源、简短、初步计划和草案,以及共同任务的指示。 提示、解码设置和源选择在评价前是固定的。

blocks.en: Coverage and text diagnostics are reported by work and condition.
blocks.zh: 覆盖面和文本诊断按工作和条件报告。

blocks.en: 6.2 Comparisons and mechanism controls
blocks.zh: 6.2 比较和机制控制

blocks.en: This control uses the same proposed edits, target scenes, and intended treatments as SceneWeave. It replaces each written scene trial with detailed scene planning that can describe exchanges, psychological possibilities, imagery, rhythm, setup in preceding scenes, and connections to later scenes. The control describes possible spoken exchanges without writing the final dialogue. The descriptions replace written trials during plan revision and complete-script generation. This contrast tests the combined contribution of written scene material to plan revision and complete writing.
blocks.zh: 此控制使用与SceneWeave相同的拟议编辑,目标场景,以及预期的处理方法. 它以详细的场景规划取代每场书面场景审判,这些场景规划可以描述交流,心理可能性,图像,节奏,前场景的设置,以及与后场景的联系. 控制描述可能的口语交换而不写最后的对话. 说明取代了计划修订和完整书写期间的书面审判。 这种对比测试了书面场景材料对规划修订和完成写作的综合贡献.

blocks.en: The baseline uses the official SuperWriter planning, writing, and refinement prompts ( Wu et al., 2026 ) . After the common initial draft, it performs refinement, full-script review, and revision with the same LLM as SceneWeave. The complete published prompts are preserved; only output-field names are adapted to the common script representation. All four conditions use the same final repetition check.
blocks.zh: 基准使用官方的SuperWriter规划,写作,以及精细的提示(Wu等人,2026年). 在共同的初始草案之后,它进行精细化,全稿审查,并以与SceneWeave相同的LLM进行修改. 完整的已公布的提示被保留;只有输出字段名称被修改以适应常见的脚本表示. 所有四个条件都采用相同的最终重复检查.

blocks.en: This control holds the source, initial draft, plan, edits, and written scene alternatives fixed. Plan revision receives either the scenes or descriptions of their intended treatments. Subsequent writing and review have access to the same scene texts, selected according to the revised plan. The contrast isolates the contribution of written scenes to the first plan-revision decision. The controlled study focuses on the scene-first strategy.
blocks.zh: 此控件将源头,初始草案,计划,编辑,以及书面场景替代品固定. 计划修订要么收到场景,要么收到关于计划治疗的说明。 之后的写作和评论可以访问相同的场景文本,这些文本是根据修订后的计划选择的. 对比隔离了书面场景对第一次计划修改决定的贡献. 控制研究侧重于场景第一战略.

blocks.en: 6.3 Outcome evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3 结果评价

blocks.en: The primary outcome is blind reader preference on complete scenes with their preceding and following passages. Before generation or scoring, each work receives a source situation anchor. Scenes are matched by roles and situations under permitted changes to cast, setting, actions, and ending; unreliable correspondences are unassessable. Readers receive the source facts and common brief, start with one pair, and may continue with other works. Assignment balances completed judgments across works and contrasts. The judgment covers the displayed encounter and its context.
blocks.zh: 主要结果是,在完整的场景中,读者偏好盲目阅读,其前后各段都是这样。 在生成或评分之前,每部作品都会得到一个源情况锚. 场景在允许的改变下与角色和情况相匹配,以进行设定、设定、行动和结束;不可靠的通信是无法评估的。 读者接受来源事实和共同简报,从一对开始,可以继续其他作品. 各项工程和对比的指派平衡完成判决。 判决涵盖了所显示的遭遇及其背景.

blocks.en: Close reading examines changes in scene arrangement, dialogue, action, and relationships relative to the shared initial draft. Content assessment summarizes these properties across complete scripts.
blocks.zh: 密切阅读会检查场景安排,对话,动作以及与共享初始草案的关系的变化. 内容评估总结了这些完整脚本的属性.

blocks.en: Readers choose A, B, tie, or unable to judge and provide a brief reason grounded in the scene and its supplied context. Method identities and model judgments are hidden. Appendix E details presentation and assignment.
blocks.zh: 读者选择A,B,领带,或无法判断,并提供基于场景及其提供的背景的简短理由. 方法身份和模型判断被隐藏. 附 录 E 详细介绍和任务。

blocks.en: Human preference scores are 1 for SceneWeave, 0 for the baseline, and 0.5 for a tie. Unable-to-judge responses count toward coverage and are excluded from the score. Scores are averaged within works, then across works. SuperWriter is the primary contrast; the two controls are secondary.
blocks.zh: 人类偏好分数为:SceneWeave1分,基线0分,平局0.5分. 无法对法官作出的答复算在覆盖范围之内,被排除在得分之外。 得分在作品内部平均,然后跨作品. SuperWriter是主对比;两个控件是次要的.

blocks.en: Table 1: Blind scene preferences from four theatre graduate students. Wins, ties, and losses count individual judgments; preference is the mean of work-level scores, with ties assigned 0.5. The Works column gives the number of distinct source works, each judged by all four readers.
blocks.zh: 表1:四个戏剧研究生对盲人场景的偏好. 胜负,领带,损失都算个人判断;偏好是工作级别分数的平均值,领带分配0.5. "Works"栏目给出了不同来源作品的数量,每个作品都由所有四个读者判断.

blocks.en: 7 Results
blocks.zh: 7 结果

blocks.en: 7.1 Human scene preferences
blocks.zh: 7.1 人类场景偏好

blocks.en: Four theatre graduate students each judged eight anonymous bilingual pairs from distinct works: four against SuperWriter and two for each mechanism control, yielding 32 judgments. English originals were displayed alongside Chinese translations. Pairs were selected to keep the reading load manageable while preserving complete scenes, without consulting preference scores. All conditions used the common API model. Four judgments were ties; none were abstentions.
blocks.zh: 4名戏剧研究生每人从不同的作品中判断了8对匿名双语双人:4人反对SuperWriter,2人负责机制控制,得出32个判断. 英文原件与中文译本同时展示。 选对子是为了保持阅读负荷的可控性,同时保留完整的场景,而不咨询偏好分数. 所有条件都使用了通用的API模型. 四项判决是相关联的,无一是弃权。

blocks.en: Table 1 shows more favorable judgments for SceneWeave in all three contrasts. Against the SuperWriter prompt workflow, three works favored SceneWeave and one was evenly divided; excluding ties, its win rate was 11/15 (73.3%). The detailed-planning contrast split by work, while one plan-revision comparison received three ties. Mean pairwise agreement among readers was 50% against SuperWriter, 75% for detailed planning, and 50% for the plan-revision contrast; agreement is the proportion of reader pairs making the same A, B, or tie choice within each work.
blocks.zh: 表1显示在三种对比中,SceneWeave的判断更为有利。 与SuperWriter即时工作流程相比,三部作品偏爱SceneWeave,一部作品平分;不包括领带,其胜率为11/15(73.3%). 详细规划的对比是按工作划分的,而一项计划修订比较有三个联系。 读者之间的平均对等协议是:50%反对SuperWriter,75%支持详细规划,50%支持计划-修订对比;协议是每部作品中做出相同A,B或搭配选择的读者对的比例.

blocks.en: 7.2 Complete-script content diagnostics
blocks.zh: 7.2 全文内容诊断

blocks.en: The complete-script comparison uses fifteen works with complete drafts and candidate-selection judgments for every method, excluding two method-development works. Cohort membership is fixed by availability before outcome analysis. Methods share the source, brief, initial plan, and initial script. SceneWeave generates one candidate per adaptation strategy; each baseline receives four generation opportunities. Within each method, the frozen preference model compares these candidates with the initial script and selects the candidate with the most wins minus losses, using fixed tie-breaking. The selected scripts, including retained initial drafts, enter the content assessment below.
blocks.zh: 完整描述的比较采用15部作品,其中对每种方法都有完整的草稿和候选人甄选判断,不包括两个方法开发作品. 共同成员由成果分析之前的可用性确定。 方法共享源,简,初计划,初脚本. 场景Weave每个适应战略产生1个候选;每个基准获得4个生成机会. 在每种方法中,冷冻的首选模式将这些候选人与最初的脚本进行比较,并选择得分最多的候选人减亏,使用固定的领带破解. 所选的脚本,包括保留的初稿,在下面输入内容评估.

blocks.en: The baselines are the released SuperWriter prompt workflow, a component-level implementation of Dramaturge ( Xie et al., 2025 ) , and a strong prompt workflow using approach-specific writing instructions. Dramaturge retains global and scene-level review, separate description and dialogue editing, and structural and detail revision phases. Appendix A gives its stopping conditions. All methods use gpt-6-luna .
blocks.zh: 基准是发布的SuperWriter即时工作流程,Dramaturge(Xie等人,2025年)的组件级执行,以及使用方法特定写作指令的强烈即时工作流程. 戏剧保留了全球和场景一级的审查、单独的描述和对话编辑以及结构和细节修订阶段。 附 录 A给它停止的条件。 所有的方法都使用gpt-6-luna.

blocks.en: We adapt the five DramaBench content dimensions to complete adaptations ( Ma et al., 2026 ) . Every method is assessed on the same fifteen works using the original brief. gpt-6-luna annotates the frozen selected scripts with method identities concealed; identical scripts share annotations. Deterministic units delimit action paragraphs, complete dialogue turns, and scene boundaries.
blocks.zh: 我们调整了五个Drama Bench的内容维度,以完成修改(Ma等人,2026年)。 每种方法都使用原始简报对同样的15部作品进行评估。 gpt-6-luna 用方法身份隐藏了被冻结的选定脚本; 相同的脚本共享说明 。 决定性单位划定动作段落,完整对话框转弯,以及场景边界.

blocks.en: Narrative redundancy, character inconsistency, distinctive dialogue and world-continuity errors are calculated from categorical labels. Psychological and conflict treatment use three separately anchored criteria each. Psychological treatment assesses particularity, realization and development; conflict assesses tension, development and integration within the brief. Levels are zero for a substantive failure, one for legible but generic or thin treatment, two for convincing specific treatment, and three for finely differentiated and integrated treatment. The grade for each reading is the median of the three criterion levels; the grades from two readings are averaged.
blocks.zh: 叙述性冗余,性格不一致,有区别的对话框和世界连续错误都是从断然的标签计算出来的. 心理治疗和冲突治疗各采用三个单独的固定标准。 心理治疗评估特殊性、实现和发展;冲突评估紧张局势、发展和融入情况。 实质故障的等级为0级,1级为可辨别但通用的或稀薄的处理,2级为令人信服的具体处理,3级为细微差别和综合处理. 每读的分数为三个标准等级的中位数;两个读数的分数为平均值.

blocks.en: Table 2: Complete-script content assessment on fifteen matched works. Redundancy, out-of-character dialogue (OOC), and world-continuity errors are lower-is-better rates; character-specific voice is higher-is-better. Rates are percentages averaged across scripts. Emotion and Conflict use higher-is-better anchored grades (0–3), combining three criteria and two readings.
blocks.zh: 表2:对15部匹配作品的完整内容评估. 冗余,外形对话(OOC),和世界连续误差是比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比比. 比率是各文稿的平均百分比。 “情感与冲突”使用更高的定位等级(0-3),结合了三个标准和两个读数。

blocks.en: Table 2 shows the lowest mean redundancy for SceneWeave and the same mean emotion grade as the strong prompt workflow. SuperWriter has the highest distinctive-dialogue rate; SuperWriter and the strong prompt workflow have the highest mean conflict grade. All methods have zero annotated OOC violations. Appendix D defines the annotation units and scoring rules.
blocks.zh: 表2显示SceneWeave的平均冗余率最低,与强速工作流程相同的平均情感等级. SuperWriter的独角对话率最高;SuperWriter和强速工作流程的平均冲突等级最高. 所有方法均无附带说明的OOC违规行为。 附 录 D定义了注释单位和评分规则.

blocks.en: 7.3 Complete-script preference comparison
blocks.zh: 7.3 全文偏好比较

blocks.en: The frozen human-preference model compares the selected complete scripts on the common fifteen-work cohort. Both presentation orders are evaluated; A/B/tie logits are aligned to candidate identities and averaged before applying softmax. The highest-probability class supplies the outcome. All ties in this comparison correspond to identical shared initial scripts.
blocks.zh: 冷冻的人类首选模式比较了普通的15个工作组的选定完整脚本. 两种演示文稿都经过评价; A/B/tie logits与候选人身份一致,并在应用软马克斯前平均. 最高概率等级提供结果. 此比较中的所有链接都对应相同的共享初始脚本.

blocks.en: Table 3: Complete-script predictions of the frozen human-preference model. Wins, ties, and losses count predicted outcomes for SceneWeave; preference counts ties as half a win. Author-cluster intervals use 10,000 bootstrap samples. The same model selects candidates and predicts comparison outcomes.
blocks.zh: 表3:冷冻人类首选模型的完整预告. 胜负、领带和损失计算出SceneWeave的预测结果;偏好将领带计算为半赢。 作者-集群间隔使用10,000个靴子夹样本. 同一模式选择候选人并预测比较结果。

blocks.en: Table 3 reports more predicted wins than losses for SceneWeave against all three baselines.
blocks.zh: 表3显示,相对于所有三个基线而言,SceneWeave的预测赢家多于损失。

blocks.en: 7.4 Hybrid-writing case analysis
blocks.zh: 7.4 混合写作案例分析

blocks.en: We analyze four scenes to examine how particular writing choices affect dramatic treatment. Both workflows use the scene-first method and share the source, brief, initial plan, and draft. The hybrid uses the fine-tuned local writer (Appendix C ) for scene trials and gpt-6-luna for plan revision and complete-script integration; the API-only workflow uses gpt-6-luna throughout.
blocks.zh: 我们分析四个场景,来研究具体的写作选择如何影响戏剧性的治疗. 两种工作流程都采用场景第一方法,并共享源,简,初计划,和草稿. 混合体使用微调的本地写作机(Appendix C)进行场景试验,以及gpt-6-luna进行计划修改和完整标注整合;API专用工作流程全程使用gpt-6-luna.

blocks.en: In Lady Chatterley’s Lover , Clifford wins money while depending on Mrs. Bolton’s company. The hybrid integrates a local trial’s “You’re losing.” / “I know.” with her continued dealing and private resentment. Reader comments value how the sparse exchange allows care, indulgence, and resistance to coexist. The source supplies the contradiction; local writing gives it an additional spoken form.
blocks.zh: 在《查特利夫人的情人》中, Clifford赢得金钱, 混合体将当地审判的“你正在输 ” / “ 我知道 ” 与她的持续交易和私人怨恨结合在一起。 读者评论认为, 来源提供矛盾;当地写作给予它额外的口语形式.

blocks.en: In I Am Legend , the API-only scene leaves Neville’s hand still. The hybrid begins and interrupts a reach, giving his inward accusation a visible action to address. A local trial adds “His thumb rubs its edge,” joining the cross’s experimental use with a possible self-soothing gesture. Reader comments recognize the hesitation while also valuing the API-only scene’s spatial treatment of the earlier injection.
blocks.zh: 在《I Am Legend》中, 混血儿开始并中断了接触,使他的内在指控有了明显的处理行动. 本地审判增加 " 他的拇指抚摸着它的边缘, " 用一种可能自慰的姿态加入了十字架的实验用途。 读者评论承认犹豫,

blocks.en: George delays his lesson while students talk. The hybrid voices his interpretation of Dreyer’s support as an investment in future authority; a subsequent whisper unsettles it. The API-only scene conveys his need for recognition through a partial head-turn, faltering smile, and renewed audience contact. The difference concerns how private judgment becomes available to viewers through voice or disrupted public performance.
blocks.zh: 乔治在学生说话时拖延课时. 混血儿认为他支持德雷尔是对未来权威的投资; 只有API的场景通过部分头角,动摇的笑容和重新与观众接触来传达他获得认可的需求. 不同之处在于,如何通过声音向观众提供私人判断,或干扰公共表演。

blocks.en: In David Copperfield , the hybrid prolongs a gesture from the shared initial draft: Mowcher questions David’s prejudice while their hands remain joined. The local trial expands the pause and distance cue. Readers recognize its ambiguity, but prefer the API-only scene’s clearer step, release, and level gaze. Their comments criticize the hybrid’s explanatory directions: a meaningful gesture loses interpretive space when its significance is immediately stated.
blocks.zh: 在David Copperfield中, 混合体延长了共享初始草案的姿态: 莫彻质疑大卫的偏见, 当地审判扩大了暂停和距离提示. 读者认识到它的模糊性,但倾向于只使用API的场景更清晰的一步,释放,以及平面视线. 他们的评论批评混合体的解释性方向:有意义的姿态当其意义立即被说明时会失去解释性空间.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: SceneWeave writes alternative encounters and uses them to revise characterization and the surrounding adaptation. The four-reader study favors SceneWeave over the SuperWriter prompt workflow and both mechanism controls in aggregate; the qualitative cases identify specific uses of dialogue, action, and viewpoint that shape reader response.
blocks.zh: SceneWeave写了另类遭遇,并用它们来修改特征和周围的适应. 四读者研究倾向于SceneWeave优于SuperWriter的即时工作流程和两种机制控制的总和;定性案例确定了对话、行动和观点的具体用途,从而形成读者的反应。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: The study covers prose passages and short connected scripts. The primary blind study includes four theatre graduate students and eight works. Translation and reader familiarity may influence preferences, while model-annotated content grades depend on annotation accuracy. Complete-script preference predictions use the same model for candidate selection and evaluation. Two scene alternatives cover only part of the adaptation space, and integration may lose useful details. The preference model uses human and synthetic supervision; incomplete source provenance and possible pretraining exposure limit unseen-work claims. Future work can investigate whether larger writing models trained on more high-quality adaptation and human-preference data improve script quality while maintaining alignment with reader preferences. Full-novel adaptation and broader audience reception remain to be studied.
blocks.zh: 该研究涵盖散文段落和短串联的脚本. 初等盲文研究包括四个戏剧研究生和八个作品. 翻译和读者熟悉可能影响到偏好,而模型附加说明的内容等级则取决于注释的准确性. 完整描述的偏好预测在选择和评价候选人时使用相同的模型. 两个场景替代品仅涵盖部分适应空间,整合可能失去有用的细节. 首选模式采用人和人合成监督;来源不完整,可能的培训前接触限制不公开的工作要求。 未来的工作可以调查在更高质量的改编和人文偏好数据方面受过训练的更大的写作模型是否在保持与读者偏好一致的同时提高了脚本质量. 全面小说适应和更广泛的受众接待仍有待研究。

blocks.en: Ethical considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: Generative artificial intelligence tools assisted with manuscript language polishing and literature search. The authors are responsible for the manuscript and the accuracy of its citations.
blocks.zh: 基因人工智能工具协助手稿语言抛光和文献搜索. 作者对手稿及其引用的准确性负有责任。

blocks.en: Appendix A Implementation and Training Conditions
blocks.zh: 附录A 执行和培训条件

blocks.en: Scene writing returns a scene identifier and text; complete writing returns a full script. Planning, interpretation, material assignment, and review use structured outputs. Matched conditions share the source, brief, initial plan and draft, and model assignments. Scenes with assigned trial material are rewritten in the revised context; other scenes are written from their plan descriptions.
blocks.zh: 场景写入返回场景标识符和文本;完整写入返回完整的脚本. 规划、解释、物资分配和审查使用结构化产出。 匹配的条件共享源、简要、初步计划和草案以及模式任务。 带有指定审判材料的场景在订正上下文中重写;其他场景则从其计划描述中写出.

blocks.en: The complete set of proposed edits is validated and applied to the specified plan. A merge operation specifies its input scene identifiers and replaces the corresponding scene entries with the merged scene; a split replaces its parent with ordered new scenes. For each alternative edit, scenes for trial writing are selected after the edits are applied, including surviving replacements, insertions, moves, merges, and splits, in the resulting presentation order. Deletions redirect writing to surviving scenes adjacent to the deletion and to declared dependent scenes. Changes confined to overall adaptation choices retain the surviving focal scene as the default. The resulting scene list is checked before it is passed to the writing model.
blocks.zh: 完整的一套拟议编辑经过验证,适用于规定的计划。 合并操作指定其输入场景标识符,并将相应的场景条目替换为合并场景;拆分操作用命令的新场景替换其母. 对于每个替代编辑,在应用编辑后会选择用于试写的场景,包括存活的替换,插入,移动,合并,和拆分,在相应的演示文稿顺序中. 删除将写入重定向到与删除相邻的幸存场景和宣布的依赖场景. 限于总体适应选择的变化保留了幸存的焦点场景作为默认. 由此产生的场景列表在传递到写作模型之前会被检查.

blocks.en: The previous draft is retained only if review identifies unintended repetition in the revision and quotes a passage of at least 160 characters that occurs at least twice, with more occurrences than in the previous draft.
blocks.zh: 只有在审查发现修订中出现意外重复,并引述至少发生两次的至少160个字符的段落,出现次数比前一草案多的情况下,才能保留前一个草案。

blocks.en: SuperWriter prompts are taken from official repository commit 436149d87908a462b5f74270cb43d797163f6e17 . Planning supplies the common outline; writing and refinement use the shared LLM. The complete instructions and generated screenplay text are preserved when adapting output fields.
blocks.zh: SuperWriter提示从官方寄存器中提取 承诺 436149d87908a462b5f74270cb43d797163f6e17 。 。 。 规划提供共同纲要;编写和完善使用共享的LLM. 完整指令和生成的剧本文本在调整输出字段时保留.

blocks.en: Dramaturge permits at most two outer iterations, an improvement threshold of one on its original 100-point internal scale, and three consecutive unsuccessful detail iterations before stopping.
blocks.zh: 戏剧最多允许两个外迭,其改进阈值为原来的100分内部尺度上的一个,停止前连续三次不成功的细节迭代.

blocks.en: We fine-tune a pretrained decision model with LoRA, retaining its pointer head for A, B, and tie. Human and synthetic comparisons train the model; human validation loss selects the checkpoint. Development preferences support calibration, with test labels excluded from model selection. The supplementary materials provide model revisions and training configurations.
blocks.zh: 我们和LORA一起微调一个预先训练过的决定模型, 保留其A,B的指针头,和领带. 人与人比较和合成比较训练模型;人验证损失选择检查点. 开发偏好支持校准,测试标签被排除在模型选择之外. 补充材料提供模式修订和培训配置。

blocks.en: For probability evaluation, A/B/tie logits from both presentation orders are aligned to the original candidate identities, averaged, and converted to probabilities with softmax. Disagreement between the two original judgments is reported separately.
blocks.zh: 对于概率评价,来自两个演示文稿命令的 A/B/tie logits 都与原始候选身份对齐,平均,并转换为带有软max的概率. 两项原判决的分歧另行报告.

blocks.en: Appendix B Data Sources and Preparation
blocks.zh: 附录B 数据来源和编制

blocks.en: Arena releases provide user comparisons; PPE provides public pairwise judgments; HelpSteer2/3 provide human preferences, including individual signed judgments where available. Screening checks the requested task, both texts, available context, and dramatic form. We retain source identifiers, upstream partitions, annotation origin, and the study partition. Annotator explanations and response-model identities are excluded from comparison inputs.
blocks.zh: Arena发行提供用户比较;PPE提供公共对等判断;HelpSteer2/3提供人类偏好,包括个人签名判断(如果有的话). 筛选检查所要求的任务,包括文本、现有上下文和戏剧形式。 我们保留了源识别符,上游分区,注释源,以及研究分区. 注释人的解释和反应模型身份被排除在比较投入之外。

blocks.en: LAMP supplies original drafts and professional revisions ( Chakrabarty et al., 2025b ; Chakrabarty et al., 2025a ) . The Benchmark of Expert-edited Machine-generated Outputs (Beemo) supplies model drafts and human edits ( Artemova et al., 2025 ) ; its generation and rewriting records are filtered for narrative tasks. HelpSteer3’s edit subset supplies conversational context, feedback, and a human-edited response ( Wang et al., 2025a ) . These form draft-to-revision and feedback-conditioned revision examples. LAMP edit spans are aligned to the complete revised target and remain annotations within each example.
blocks.zh: LAMP提供原始草稿和专业修订(Chakrabarty等人,2025b;Chakrabarty等人,2025a)。 专家编辑的机器生成产出基准(Beemo)提供模型草稿和人文编辑(Artemova等人,2025年);其生成和重写记录被过滤用于叙述任务. 帮助 指导3编辑子集提供对话背景、反馈和人文编辑的回应(Wang等人,2025a)。 这些是修订稿和有反馈条件的修订实例。 LAMP 编辑间隔与完整的修订目标一致,并保留每个示例中的说明.

blocks.en: DramaBench supplies context–continuation pairs ( Ma et al., 2025 ) . We verify that the prefix and continuation reconstruct the released script. The Cinematic Markup Language Benchmark (CML-Bench) supplies screenplay segments ( Zheng et al., 2025 ) ; Extensible Markup Language (XML) fields are rendered in order, preserving scene descriptions, characters, dialogue, and parentheticals. Malformed structures are excluded. SingleScenes supplies scene synopses and scripts ( supergeniodelmale, ) ; the retained material comes from Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind . Synopsis-to-scene supervision uses these reference-derived synopses as inputs, with all examples from the film assigned to a single study partition.
blocks.zh: Drama Bench提供上下文 - 连续对(Ma等人,2025年)。 我们核实前缀和继续重建了已发布的脚本. 电影马克语言基准(CML-Bench)提供剧本片段(郑等人,2025年);可扩展马克语言(XML)字段按顺序提供,保存场景描述,人物,对话,和括号. 结构不整齐的除外。 SingleScees提供场景概要和剧本(supergeniodelmale, );保留的材料来自Spotless Mind的永恒阳光. 简表到场景监督使用这些参考衍生的简表作为投入,电影中的所有实例都分配到一个单一的研究分区.

blocks.en: Private prose–adaptation pairs provide passage-to-scene examples, and a private screenplay collection provides adjacent-scene continuation examples. Public metadata from the bilingual narrative benchmark STAGE: Evolving Stories supplies identifiers for part of the latter collection ( roytian1992, ) . Passage correspondence is checked separately from a work-level adaptation link, using edition, source boundaries, scene boundaries, participants, and depicted events. The prose-only input omits its reference scene; revision tasks provide the existing scene as the draft input. Private source texts are not redistributed.
blocks.zh: 私人的改编配对提供了通道到场景的例子,一个私人的剧本集提供了相邻的场景续作的例子. 双语叙事基准STAGE中的公共元数据: 不断演变的故事为后者的部分收藏提供了识别资料(Roytian-1992,......)。 通过函文与工作级的适应链接分开检查,使用版本,源边界,场景边界,参与者,以及描绘的事件. 唯利是图的输入省略了它的参考场景;修订任务提供了作为草稿输入的现有场景. 私人来源文本不重新分配。

blocks.en: Synthetic examples retain their teacher identity, source group, task, and input–output record. Writing targets generated or rewritten by a model are labeled synthetic. Synthetic preference pairs use the same request for both drafts and preserve their annotation provenance. Filtering checks dramatic form, consistency with the brief, presentation-order agreement where applicable, and whether judgments reward fidelity or departure without a stated dramatic benefit.
blocks.zh: 合成实例保留他们的教师身份、源组、任务和输入-输出记录。 由模型生成或重写的写入目标被标签为合成. 合成偏好对两种草案都使用相同的请求,并保留其注释来源. 过滤检查戏剧性的形式,在适用的情况下是否符合简要的、呈报顺序的协议,以及判决是奖励忠诚,还是在没有说明戏剧性好处的情况下离开。

blocks.en: Known work, adaptation, author, prompt, and revision-family links determine which examples belong to the same study group. Exact normalized-text duplicates and reversed copies of the same preference pair are removed. Writer records are screened against known held-out groups and text fingerprints; overlap review is triggered when at least 85% of the distinct five-token sequences in the shorter text occur in the longer text, provided that at least 25 distinct sequences are available. Full inputs and targets are checked for missing fields, task compatibility, and compliance with token-length limits. Data manifests retain source versions, extraction rules, partitions, and original human labels.
blocks.zh: 已知的作品,改编,作者,即时,以及修订-家族链接决定了哪些例子属于同一个研究组. 同一首选配对的准确的正版文本复制和反转副本被删除。 写作记录要对照已知的搁置组和文本指纹进行筛选;如果较长的文本中至少有85%的5个不同的音节序列出现,则会触发重叠审查,条件是至少有25个不同的序列。 检查全部输入和目标是否缺少字段、任务兼容性以及是否符合符号长度限制。 数据表保留了源版本,提取规则,分区,以及原始人类标签.

blocks.en: Appendix C A Task-conditioned Local Writer
blocks.zh: 附录C 本地作家

blocks.en: The local writer is obtained by fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B with LoRA ( Qwen Team, 2026 ; Hu et al., 2022 ) on adaptation, scene writing, continuation, and revision examples. Supervised learning uses complete target texts. Human preference alignment uses direct preference optimization with a Davidson extension for ties ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , followed by task-specific scene training with supervised replay. Checkpoints are selected using fixed validation data.
blocks.zh: 本地作家通过微调Qwen3.5-9B与Lora(Quen Team,2026;Hu et al.,2022)在改编,场景写作,续作,以及修订实例上获得. 监督学习使用完整的目标文本. 人类偏好配对采用直接偏好优化,并带有Davidson扩展的领带(Rafailov等人,2023年;Chen等人,2025年),之后进行任务特定场景训练,并进行有监督的重播. 使用固定验证数据选择检查站。

blocks.en: The controlled method comparison uses the API model throughout. In the hybrid case study, the local writer generates scene trials and the API model revises the plan and integrates the complete script. Training configurations and model identifiers are supplied in the supplementary materials.
blocks.zh: 控制方法比较在整个过程中使用API模型. 在混合案例研究中,当地作家生成场景试验,API模型修改计划,整合完整的脚本. 补充材料中提供了培训配置和模型标识。

blocks.en: Appendix D Full-Script Content Diagnostics
blocks.zh: 附录D 完整脚本内容诊断

blocks.en: Four human-labeled preference examples from the training set and their released explanations guide the annotation instructions. Their original pairwise choices are retained as context. Conflict annotations distinguish principal, supporting, and background tensions, with each criterion assessed within the requested adaptation scope. Direct expression, subtext, quiet encounters, confrontation, and open or resolved endings share the same grade anchors.
blocks.zh: 培训中四个带有人类标志的首选例子及其发布的解释指导了注释说明。 它们最初的对偶选择作为上下文保留. 冲突说明区分主要、支持和背景紧张,每项标准在所要求的适应范围内评估。 直接表达,子文字,安静的相遇,对抗,以及开放或解析的结局共享相同的等级锚.

blocks.en: Complete drafts from the last finished iteration remain eligible after an interrupted later iteration; partial drafts are excluded. The first complete annotation under the fixed rubric is retained; scoring follows candidate selection.
blocks.zh: 上次完成的重排的完整草稿在以后的重排中断后仍然有资格;部分草稿除外。 保留固定标题下的第一个完整的注释;评分随候选人的甄选。

blocks.en: A fixed unit is an action paragraph or a complete dialogue turn within a scene. Speaker cues on separate lines or before a colon identify dialogue. Headings mark scene boundaries; titles and transitions remain contextual material outside unit denominators. Coverage of eligible units is checked programmatically. The same fifteen source works enter every column and every baseline contrast.
blocks.zh: 固定单元是一个动作段落或一个场景内的完整对话框。 单行或先于结肠识别对话框发出扬声器提示 。 标题标记场景边界;标题和过渡仍然是单位分母以外的背景材料。 对合格单位的覆盖范围进行方案检查。 同一15个来源的作品输入了每一列和每一基线对比.

blocks.en: Let R , N R,N count units labeled redundant and nonredundant, respectively; let O , I , U O,I,U count assessable dialogue turns labeled out-of-character, in-character, and neutral, respectively. Let S , G S,G count dialogue turns with specific and generic voices, respectively, and let V , M V,M count violated and maintained world constraints, respectively. The rates are r rep \displaystyle r_{\mathrm{rep}} = R R + N , \displaystyle=\frac{R}{R+N}, r ooc \displaystyle r_{\mathrm{ooc}} = O O + I + U , \displaystyle=\frac{O}{O+I+U}, (3) r voice \displaystyle r_{\mathrm{voice}} = S S + G , \displaystyle=\frac{S}{S+G}, r logic \displaystyle r_{\mathrm{logic}} = V V + M . \displaystyle=\frac{V}{V+M}. Uncertain labels and irrelevant facts stay outside their respective denominators. Observed conduct and object states are world facts; unverified character reports remain separate. blocks.en: Psychological particularity concerns these people’s specific relationships and lived circumstances. Realization concerns how their experience becomes perceptible through particular expression and response, including effective direct speech. Development concerns the psychological course or sustained contradiction within the brief, without requiring an altered endpoint or more emotional events. Conflict tension concerns enacted incompatible needs or positions; development concerns motivated responses and consequences; integration concerns preparation, connections between scenes, and final treatment. Either dimension can receive the highest grade for a concentrated, simple, quiet, or comic treatment. Complexity, escalation, closure and ambiguity earn no automatic credit.
blocks.zh: 心理特殊性关系到这些人的具体关系和生活环境。 实现问题涉及他们的经验如何通过特定的表达和反应,包括有效的直接发言而变得可察觉。 发展涉及心理过程或简报中的持续矛盾,不需要改变终点或更多的情感事件. 冲突紧张问题产生了不相容的需求或立场;发展问题引发了反应和后果;一体化问题涉及准备、场景之间的联系和最后处理。 任何一个维度都可以得到最高的等级,用于集中,简单,安静,或漫画式的待遇. 复杂性、升级、关闭和模糊性不会自动获得信贷。

blocks.en: Each pair includes a factual source card and brief, anonymous complete scenes A and B, and relevant surrounding text in script order. Omissions outside complete scenes are marked. Source cards do not specify character motivations or intended emotional effects. Source situation anchors, scene boundaries, and word counts are fixed before annotation. Scenes are matched by character roles and situations under permitted changes; cases without reliable correspondence are marked as unassessable.
blocks.zh: 每对都包括一个事实源卡和简短,匿名的完整场景A和B,以及按脚本顺序排列的相关周边文本. 完整场景外的漏出被标记. 源卡没有具体说明人物动机或意图的情感效果. 源情况锚,场景边界,和字数在注释前固定. 在允许的更改下,场景与人物角色和情况相匹配;没有可靠通信的案件被标记为不可评估.

blocks.en: Readers start with one pair and may continue with pairs from other works. Candidate order is randomized independently of method identity. Assignment favors pairs with fewer completed judgments and balances the three contrasts. Anonymous identifiers prevent repeated submission for the same pair.
blocks.zh: 读者从一对开始,可能继续使用其他作品的对子. 候选人顺序是独立于方法身份的随机化. 分配优惠对等,完成的判断较少,平衡了三种对比. 匿名识别码防止同一对重复提交。

blocks.en: Ties and inability to judge are recorded separately, with exact texts, context, and presentation order retained.
